name: get_iox_links_table
description: INSTEON ONLY. Get the `nucore` link table for a specific device -- NuCore's own stored replica of what the device's links should be, not a live device query (see get_dev_links_table for that). Free-standing -- does not touch the PLM directly, callable any time, including while a PLM-exclusive tool is running. Params: device_id (the device's address).

device_id.description: The device's real id/address, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE.
